items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: They had another band there called Al Denny, like, he took the jobs that Ernie Fields wasn't able to fulfill.

ctx.x: player, I think. They called him "Big Stack." I never knew his real name. And a couple of other fellows. I know their name, but I can't call them. I'm having a mental block. I can see them, but I can't call it.

All right. They had another band there called Al Denny, like, he took the jobs that Ernie Fields wasn't able to fulfill. You know, he was otherwise engaged. And then we had a school band that was out of sight. It was the Rhythm Aces. And then there was a band out of -- the Young band, the Grey Brothers. One of them years later married [Leomin] Lewis, who was a pianist and sang. She was a single.
Do you remember the Grey Brothers' first names?
